description: Implementation of MIME type support and validation functions for media codecs in the starboard media namespace, including support checks for audio and video codecs, key systems, and MIME types.

methods.name: IsAudioOutputSupported
methods.description: Checks if the platform supports a given audio coding type with a specified number of channels.

methods.name: IsSupportedKeySystem
methods.description: Determines if a given key system supports a specific audio or video codec.

methods.name: IsSupportedAudioCodec
methods.description: Checks if an audio codec described by ParsedMimeInfo is supported.

methods.name: IsSupportedVideoCodec
methods.description: Checks if a video codec described by ParsedMimeInfo is supported.
